text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
——Flower-san taught me what secrets lied
beyond speed. 
——Zephyr-san was the wind at my back,
blowing down from the 
highest peak.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And just when I thought I had finally found
the limits of speed! 
Beyond them, you were there, Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You showed me new sights! New brilliance!
New excitement! 
You gave me wings to fly,
so I could bakushin to far greater 
heights!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan. 
…You are the person I adore the most.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even when I was trapped in a deep, dark tunnel,
the shadows 
weighing down my feet… When it took everything
I had just to 
put one foot in front of the other,
you were there…

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Simply facing ahead, always running faster,
faster, and faster. 
You left a trail of twinkling lights behind
you, and lit up 
the path to my runway!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am Sakura Bakushin O!
Speed is the very soul of racing! 
And with that absolute speed,
there is nobody I cannot outrun! 
I am a king unlike any other!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I am North Flight! I wear a beautiful dress by the name of speed, tailored perfectly for me! I am a queen who will shine on forever!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ——And that's why we——!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
From the outside,
North Flight pulls ahead!! 
Will she take the lead!?
It's North Flight!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
No! Sakura Bakushin O refuses to back
down! 
On the inside,
Sakura Bakushin O picks up the pace once
more!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
——This is my race! You won't get past me! 
——I'll beat you! Because it's you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I can go faster!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I can go faster!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Even faster!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ——As long as I'm racing you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Brooches were originally invented to keep
clothes fixed in place. 
…You could call them the linchpin of
fashion.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san and I wanted to design such
important pieces to 
reflect ourselves. Because, you see——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to represent the "two of you",
I'm guessing?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You didn't want to stop at just brilliant. You wanted to go further… And that wasn't something you could accomplish alone.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Exactly!
…The base designs are inspired by us as
individuals… 
But when we come together as a pair——
That's when the design really shines.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's the core concept behind these
outfits. 
These clothes only shine when Bakushin O-chan
and I wear them together.
No one else could ever pull them off like
we do!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
From stem to stern,
these outfits were truly designed as a pair.
Each has a strong sense of individuality——
But when the two of you stand 
side by side, the design becomes complete.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh… It all makes sense now.
When I thought about the theme "Giving
You a Blessed Bouquet",
I couldn't help but imagine the two of
you together, and now I understand why…

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Your individual brilliances clashed in
competition, your sparks flying 
and illuminating the other,
and your hearts screaming out.
"Because I'm 
racing you. And it has to be you".

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: What blessing could be greater than that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ……Sigh——

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(In the end… I couldn't decide on an outfit.
I feel horrible making 
their time go to waste after all the help
they gave me)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(When the two of them explained their
outfits… 
It only made me feel more lost——)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ……They shone bright because it was the two of them together. ……And only because it was the two of them together——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ——Hey! If you don't pop that open soon, it'll get all warm, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh…! 
R-Right. Thank you, Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wait, actually,
I'm sorry!
It's terribly rude of me to block the 
vending machine…!
Let me get out of your way——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. 
I'm not here to buy a drink.
I'm here for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: What…?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Say, Tact. 
——Would you mind clearing up your schedule
this weekend? 
For me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Phew…!
Would this be enough vegetables for
lunch? 
Excuse me, Tact-san——

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Er, Tact-san? Heart-san——?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh! 
I'll be right down, Bouquet-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Eek! Whaaaat!? You were up there!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sorry!
We just happened to find a tree that was
real tall, even by this place's standards.
We were tying a 
flag up there just in case we get into an
emergency.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even if worse comes to worst and we need a
helicopter to find 
us, this flag will give us peace of mind ♪
But I have to apologize 
for leaving you on your own, Bouquet-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Looks like you picked a whole bunch of veggies for us. Thanks! Let's head back to camp for lunch!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, um, let's.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So… You will be camping in the mountains
this weekend with 
Heart-san?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will. She invited me to come with her. 
…It'll be a good opportunity for me to
rethink things.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(This reminds me… Ever since we went to pick
out the outfits, 
there have been a few occasions where I saw
Tact-san deep in thought.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me——
I will do my utmost to stay out of the way,
so—— 
Would you be willing to let me come with
you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I came here because I wanted to be there
to talk with her when she needed me,
but… She scarcely needs the help when these
mountains are 
practically her own backyard…)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bouqueeet? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh—— I- I apologize! 
I'll be right there!
